SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. O. D. 19
I.O. CHINESE SECTION. Station,
Date
Date MARCH 21st. 1929.

Subject (in full) COMMUNIST LITERATURE.

Made by C.D.I. J.W. Prince Forwarded by H. Evans H.C. Pol.

Reference to the attached inquiries, so far, have
failed to discover the place of origin, or the author of this
publication, which is deemed to be of a distinctly communistic
nature. Please see translations of passages marked on pages
17 & 23, attached! Mr. Chao Wan Tung (周雲東) local Chief
Inspector in the Chinese Postal Service informs me that they
have seized numerous copies of this publication which had been
posted in the names of the International Dispensary, Messrs
Evans & Sons, Commercial Press, the Pah Ling Dispensary and
other firms, and that all endeavours, by the Postal Authorities,
to detect the sender have so far been in vain.

We have made inquiries of News Agencies, Book-
stores, and printers, regarding the book and wrapper but with-
out success.

（批：Filed on / instruction of / A.C.(d) 21/3）

A.C.P. Pol.
（印：ACKNOWLEDGED 21 3 1929）
C.I.D. Reg.
Please thank the International
Dispensary for their information and tell
them we shall let them know if we trace any further.
J.W. Prince
C.D.I.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C.I.D. HEADQUARTERS.
POLITICAL BRANCH.
Shanghai, 11: 3: 1929

wrapper were printed.

the book which are
distinctly communistic.
J. McEwen

ADDRESSED TO THE HEAD OFFICE, SHANGHAI

SHANGHAI, 8th March, 1929.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

We have just found out that there are men in no way connected
with us making use of our name to distribute pamphlets and other papers
of a Bolshevik nature. One of these pamphlets distributed failing to
reach its destination, it has been returned to us by the post office.
We are sending you for your reference this pamphlet with our name in
its wrapper.

After reporting this matter to the Municipal Authority of
the Greater Shanghai, we wish to make it known to you as well, so that
the guilty party, if he should be hiding in the Settlements, may be
arrested and similar offences prevented for the future.

We are,

Yours faithfully,

INTERNATIONAL DISPENSARY CO., LTD.

F. D. Zau
Secretary.
